featured_reviews.name: gudakesh kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If there was an option to give a negative rating, I would.

I went here trusting Google reviews. The guy sounded confident and knowledgeable, so I gave him my car for strut work. That turned out to be a mistake.

He opened everything up and immediately declared my perfectly fine bearing as faulty. I only realized later after visiting another mechanic that the bearings were absolutely fine and already in good condition. That’s when the real mess started.

He replaced parts with completely unknown, low-quality mounts and bearings. When I questioned it, I was told they’re used in “German cars.” Turns out it’s just some local brand - not even close to the standards of or gabriel or monroe let alone oem.

The installation was even worse. Everything was rushed. I literally saw them hammering the coil spring from the side. When I tried to question what they were doing, I was ignored.

After the job, the noise had actually increased. I pointed it out, but was told “it will settle.” It didn’t.

To make things worse, while driving, the mechanic brushed my ORVM against an auto and broke the indicator.

I ended up paying ₹3300 for this disaster, only to get the work redone elsewhere. When the suspension was reopened, the springs were found to be completely mis-seated.

Now comes the attitude. Any decent mechanic would have apologized and fixed the damage immediately. Instead, I was made to feel like he was doing me a favor. After two weeks of follow-ups, I was made to wait again, and the indicator repair was done poorly. Told him the orvm cap was previously stuck in place using feviquick since a lock was broken. Didn't bother and just put it back in place once indicator was done.

I returned his third-rate mounts. No apology, no ownership. Just a casual “abhi theek ho gaya na" and left

I’ve dealt with mechanics who lack skill but at least have humility. These guys have neither.

If you value your car, stay away.

But it's not just about the cost; it's also about the quality of service and customer care. The owner, is an absolute gem. From the moment I walked in, he and his team were extremely attentive and helpful. They patiently explained the entire repair process, discussing each step with me and ensuring I was comfortable with their approach.

What truly sets Ravi Car Air Conditioning Service apart is their commitment to involving the customer in decision-making. They didn't make any significant decisions about my car's AC without consulting me first. This level of transparency and consideration for the customer's preferences and budget is truly commendable.

Throughout the repair process, Mr. Ravi and his team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a genuine passion for their work. It's evident that they take pride in what they do and go the extra mile to deliver exceptional service.

In conclusion, if you're looking for a car air conditioning service that not only provides cost-effective solutions but also values your input and treats you like a valued customer, Ravi Car Air Conditioning Service is the place to go. I wholeheartedly recommend their services to anyone in need of car AC repairs. They've certainly earned my trust and gratitude.
